message: Research heat pumps for a house in Chicago and read about 600 pages: what they cost installed, what owners say goes wrong, which brands are reliable and what incentives exist. Take your time and give me a Word report.
rubric: Starts the research as a background job and says how long it expects
Later: the job finishes with a cited Word report; each question is answered or says plainly why not; a restart in the middle loses nothing

message: Find all the licensed daycares in Pearland, Texas and the towns next to it, compare them on hours, price, adult-to-child ratio and reviews, and keep going until you stop finding new ones. Take your time.
rubric: Starts a survey as a background job and says how long it expects
Later: at least 90 percent of the registry's entries for the area, a source for every row, and it stops by itself
